s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.body: Transcendence (the "Service") is an online Quoridor platform built and operated by a student team as part of the 42 curriculum. This policy explains what information the Service collects and how it is handled.

s2.title: 2. Information we collect
s2.body:
Account information: with Google sign-in we receive your display name, email address and profile picture; with email registration we store your email address and a hashed password.
Game data: match records (opponent, moves, results), rating, achievements and friend relations.
Uploads: avatar images you set.
Cookies: used only to keep you signed in (session) and to remember your language (NEXT_LOCALE). There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

s3.title: 3. How we use it
s3.body: Collected information is used solely to provide the Service's features (matches, spectating, statistics, friends), to prevent abuse (rate limiting, move validation) and to investigate failures.

s4.title: 4. Storage and security
s4.body: Data is stored in the Service's PostgreSQL database. Passwords, session tokens and API keys are stored only as hashes, never in their original form. Sessions expire after 7 days.

s5.title: 5. Third parties
s5.body: Apart from communicating with Google (OAuth 2.0) for authentication, we do not share or sell personal information to third parties. No external analytics or advertising services are used.

s6.title: 6. Deletion requests
s6.body: To request deletion of your account and associated personal data, contact the development team (e.g. via a repository issue). Match records are anonymized so that they can no longer identify you.

s7.title: 7. Changes
s7.body: Changes to this policy will be announced on this page, and the last-updated date above will be revised for significant changes.

s1.title: 1. About these terms
s1.body: By using the Service you agree to these terms. The Service is a non-commercial project provided as part of the 42 curriculum.

s2.title: 2. The Service
s2.body: The Service lets you play and spectate Quoridor matches in the browser, view statistics and manage friends. Features may change or be discontinued without notice.

s3.title: 3. Accounts
s3.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials (password, API keys) safe. API keys are shown only once at creation and cannot be displayed again.

s4.title: 4. Prohibited conduct
s4.body: The following are prohibited: manipulating match results by unfair means (cheating), impersonating others, attacking the Service or other users (excessive requests, exploiting vulnerabilities, etc.), and any conduct that violates applicable law.

s5.title: 5. Public API
s5.body: The Public API may only be used with an issued API key within its scopes. Requests beyond the rate limit (60 requests/minute by default) are rejected. Attempting to circumvent limits may lead to account suspension.

s6.title: 6. Disclaimer
s6.body: The Service is provided "as is" as an educational project, with no guarantee of availability or data persistence. The development team is not liable for damages arising from its use.

s7.title: 7. Changes to these terms
s7.body: Changes will be announced on this page. Continued use after a change constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
